title: Crayon Drawing Book — an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Shade the flat mask
scenes.purpose: Build the lightbulb idea in wax on a loose page using three uneven crayon passes
visuals: Overhead open book on a dark teal desk; title page on the left, loose cream leaf over the right page
Pass 1 (0.10-0.72s): light-pressure yellow diagonal hatching fills the bulb's fractured circular mask, grey base after
Pass 2 (0.74-1.16s): heavier ochre cross-hatching shades the lower-left of the mask
Pass 3 (1.13-1.51s): charcoal wax outline traced around the rim, then red rays

beats.development: Title is readable; the first light wax pass lays the flat yellow mask with paper tooth showing through
Second, heavier pass adds ochre shadow in a cross direction
Third pass outlines the bulb and draws red rays; the silhouette is complete

scenes.title: One page movement
scenes.purpose: Reveal the hand-built connected system by turning the leaf about the fixed gutter
visuals: The leaf lifts and turns right-to-left on the gutter with foreshortening, a slightly lifting outer edge and a cast shadow
Its verso lands on the left page carrying the finished bulb and 'one bright idea…'; the right page reveals the wax network and '…turns the page into a web'

beats.development: Page turn reveals the network of blue nodes, red hub and red wax links

scenes.title: Connected and held
scenes.purpose: Connect the idea to the system and hold the flat spread for reading
visuals: A red wax stroke draws from the bulb across the gutter to the first network node (no arrowhead)
Full spread held flat and still from 2.56s

beats.development: Connector stroke links the bulb to the network
Settled reading hold of title, both captions and the finished drawing

findings: Three shading passes take about 1.4s with uneven, weighted stroke timing; the page turn is a single 0.7s eased movement; the connector stroke is quick.
The title stays readable the whole time because the leaf's verso carries the same title in the same position.
justifiedHolds: 2.56-3.0s: a flat, still hold so all four lines of copy and the settled wax silhouette can be read.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects, narration or subtitles.

Demonstrated characteristic action: shade a flat mask in three passes, then reveal the hand-built subject with one page movement. STYLE.json has no preview_recipes entry and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so this action is what the preview covers.

Background: a dark teal desk chosen for the scene, with warm coarse paper pages. The swatch colours are used as roles: ink #242831, accent #9F352D, paper/edge tan #E4CEAA. Bulb yellow/ochre, grey and node blue come from the supplied illustration.
